data.headline: BHM sold 75 Lubbock units for approximately $8.0 million

claims.text: BHM completed the disposition of its interest in 75 single-family units in Lubbock, Texas, on September 30, 2026.

citation.quote: On September 30, 2026, the Company completed the disposition of its interest in 75 single-family units located in Lubbock, Texas (“Lubbock-75”) held within the Peak JV 2 portfolio.

claims.text: The transaction had an approximately $8.0 million sales price and approximately $7.3 million of net proceeds to BHM.

citation.quote: The sale of Lubbock-75 was made to an unaffiliated third party at a sales price of approximately $8.0 million, subject to certain closing costs, prorations and adjustments typical in such real estate transactions, with net proceeds to the Company of approximately $7.3 million.

claims.text: The disposition reduced BHM’s wholly owned Peak JV 2 portfolio by 75 Texas units.

citation.quote: The Company holds a full ownership interest in the Peak JV 2 portfolio. On September 30, 2026, the Company completed the disposition of its interest in 75 single-family units located in Lubbock, Texas

claims.text: The disclosed local exposure from this transaction is Lubbock, Texas; the filing does not provide rent-rule or new-supply-permit detail.
